messages:
Nina Alvarez: Quick note  I'm wrapping my contract on Apr 2 17:00 BST. Need courier label for laptop return in London, confirmation on invoice deadline, and clarity on my contractor grant exercise window.
Lila (People Ops): We'll start the checklist. Exit interview? And do you need a reference?
Nina Alvarez: Yes to interview. A short written reference would be great.
Samir Khan: I'll take the KT handoff. Nina, please add runbook links and a 15m walkthrough recording.
IT Ops: Courier pickup can be scheduled Apr 3. We'll email prepaid label. VPN + SSO deprovision Apr 3 09:00 BST. We'll also remove SSH keys and revoke PATs during the window.
Security Bot: Reminder: rotate infra secrets that referenced nina.alvarez (vault path: secret/team/analytics/nina) within 24h of deprovision.
Finance: Submit final invoice by Apr 5 EOD BST for Apr 15 payroll. Send receipts for expenses. No COBRA for UK contractors.
Legal: Contractors have separate grant terms. We'll DM grant summary and exercise window by Apr 6 and send an IP acknowledgement form.
Lila (People Ops): Exit interview scheduled Apr 4 10:00 BST. people-ops-bot will send calendar + offboarding form.
Nina Alvarez: Thanks all. Will upload KT and invoices by Apr 5. Appreciated. :pray:
